replacements.new: - [x] Identify search grammars that encode the target morphology. — ✅ `gmi-833-grammar-morphology-encoding-v1` GME-1/GME-2/GME-5/GME-6: the structural/cost route #976's L48-SCREEN declared out of lexical reach was built and run — name-blind target-exclusivity (deleting a production set changes the declared target's minimum description cost and NO other class's), exact integers. Over 14 grammar instances from 5 merged packages (12 with a verbatim-cited declared target): **7 encode their target**, all ENCODES_DISCLOSED_CHARGED, **0 ENCODES_UNDISCLOSED**; 3 also flip the selected class. The one TARGET_SPECIFIC_SHORTCUT is #897's grown library — unfolding `{m1,m2}` raises mu(REUSE_POSITIVE) 2→5 and moves selection to UNRELATED_CONTROL; the other 6 are TARGET_IS_A_PRIMITIVE (`shared`×2, `branches`, `not_s`, `rows`, `leaves`). Lexical route over 158 packages / 1,923 blocks: 37 hits, all 37 adjudicated with written reasons, 0 CONFIRMED (PARENT_LITERATURE_ATLAS 19 / AUDIT_RECORD_ECHO 10 / SUBSTRING_COLLISION 5 / PROSE_NEGATION 3) — the two routes agree on nothing, i.e. every encoding in this corpus wears a neutral production name. Detector power proven before any finding: #891's GA/GB re-found (ALPHA→BETA at w=(1,1), equal coverage), 11/11 planted shortcuts in real corpus grammars caught, 0 alarms on the clean control, 6/6 hostiles detected, 204 randomized isometry controls with 0 spurious changes, executor↔independent-oracle agreement field-for-field. 4 instances SCREENED_NOT_ADJUDICATED (3 NO_PRODUCTION_STRUCTURE, 1 NUMERIC_PARAMETER_SPACE) + 2 NO_DECLARED_TARGET are screened, not cleared; #891's boundary is cited EARNED-BY-COUNTEREXAMPLE and reproduced (3/14 instances, 55 remints), never overturned; INSTANCE-AJ9-NOSMUGGLING-SCOPE carried forward open.
